title: The Judgment on the Judean Refugees in Egypt
description: Jeremiah warns the Judean refugees in Egypt that their idolatrous worship of the Queen of Heaven will lead to destruction by sword and famine. The people refuse to listen and insist on continuing their offerings, but the prophet declares that only a small remnant will return to Judah, citing Pharaoh Hophra's downfall as proof that God's word will stand.
